title: Latent Debate: A Surrogate Framework for Interpreting LLM Thinking towards Binary Decisions
abstract: arXiv:2512.01909v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Understanding the internal `thinking' process of Large Language Models (LLMs) and %how this relates their connections to hallucinations remains a key challenge. To this end, we introduce \emph{latent debate}, a structured surrogate framework for interpreting model outputs on True/False prediction tasks through the lens of internal latent arguments and interactions amongst them. Unlike human debates, latent debate captures the hidden supporting and attacking signals that arise within a model during a single inference. We first present a model- and task-agnostic conceptual framework, and then instantiate it symbolically to approximate the thinking process of LLMs towards binary decisions. Empirical studies demonstrate that our latent debate is a faithful structured surrogate model that has highly consistent predictions with the original LLM, while providing a form of interpretability. translated_title: 潜在辩论：一种用于解释大语言模型二分类决策思考过程的代理框架
translated_abstract: 理解大语言模型（LLMs）的内部“思考”过程及其与幻觉之间的关联仍然是一个关键挑战。为此，我们引入了“潜在辩论”，这是一个结构化的代理框架，通过内部潜在论证及其相互作用的视角来解释模型在真假预测任务上的输出。与人类辩论不同，潜在辩论捕捉的是模型在单次推理过程中产生的隐藏的支持与攻击信号。我们首先提出了一个与模型和任务无关的概念框架，然后将其符号化实例化，以近似LLM走向二分类决策的思考过程。实证研究表明，我们的潜在辩论是一个忠实的结构化代理模型，其预测与原始LLM高度一致，同时提供了一种可解释性形式。我们还证明了我们的潜在辩论提供了……
tldr: 本文提出“潜在辩论”框架，通过捕捉大语言模型在单次推理中内部潜在论证之间的支持与攻击信号，构建了与原模型预测高度一致且具备可解释性的结构化代理模型，用以解释LLM在真假预测任务上的二分类决策思考过程。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces "latent debate," a structured surrogate framework that captures hidden supporting and attacking signals among internal latent arguments within a single LLM inference, providing a faithful and interpretable approximation of how LLMs think towards binary decisions on True/False prediction tasks.
